question: Should OpenClaw core adopt ordered, read-only startup config layers as a supported Gateway CLI contract, or should managed hosts continue composing configuration outside core?
rationale: The patch is an opt-in but permanent public configuration mode, and repository policy sets a high bar for adding config/CLI surfaces; code review cannot infer whether maintainers want to own this contract.

options.title: Require RFC sponsorship first
options.body: Keep the PR draft until maintainers approve the managed-configuration direction, then repair the path-scoping defect and complete upgrade proof.

options.title: Keep composition external
options.body: Decline the new core flag and have hosts materialize or validate the effective canonical configuration through their own deployment adapter.

recommendation.title: Require RFC sponsorship first
recommendation.body: Keep the PR draft until maintainers approve the managed-configuration direction, then repair the path-scoping defect and complete upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person was explicitly brought into the PR discussion around the managed-configuration direction and is the best available routing signal.
